description: Source code for a Bluetooth ISO broadcast receiver implementation using Zephyr RTOS, handling Bluetooth scanning, synchronization, and statistics collection.

methods.name: phy2str
methods.description: Converts PHY type code to human-readable string.

methods.name: data_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse Bluetooth advertisement data and extract device name.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Handles received scan data, identifies broadcaster based on device name.

methods.name: sync_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful periodic advertisement sync.

methods.name: term_cb
methods.description: Callback for termination of periodic advertisement sync.

methods.name: biginfo_cb
methods.description: Callback for receiving BIG info, sets parameters for BIG sync.

methods.name: iso_recv
methods.description: Handles incoming ISO data packets, updates stats.

methods.name: iso_disconnected
methods.description: Handles ISO channel disconnection event, calculates duration.

methods.name: create_big_sync
methods.description: Creates BIG sync based on received BIG info.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up sync and BIG resources.

methods.name: test_run_receiver
methods.description: Main function to run the Bluetooth ISO broadcast receiver test.
